jess (eng-platform): Heads-up — we need a short data/metrics contract for KV + prefix cache effectiveness so Console can build the dashboard and Runtime/Infra can ship telemetry. Focus: hit rate, evictions, reuse_by_workload. Can folks confirm their preferences for metric names, labels, aggregation windows, and cardinality guardrails?

ryan (eng-runtime): +1. From runtime perspective we can emit these, but we need to be explicit about labels. Proposal: `kvcache.hit_total`, `kvcache.miss_total`, `kvcache.evictions_total`, and `kvcache.reuse_count`. Labels: `model_family`, `workload_type` (prod/canary/test), `tenant_tier` (free/paid/enterprise), `prefix_hash` (limited cardinality, hashed). No `tenant_id` at high-cardinality level.

anika (eng-infra): Agree on hashed `prefix` rather than raw string. Also recommend `exporter: runtime` label so infra can reconcile sources. For evictions we should add `eviction_reason` (memory_pressure/ttl/explicit_delete) — but limit values.

sam (eng-console): For dashboards we want derived rates and an effectiveness score. Suggested derived metrics: `kvcache.prefix_hit_rate = hit_total / (hit_total+miss_total)` (1m window) and `kvcache.reuse_per_tenancy = sum(reuse_count) by (workload_type, tenant_tier) / active_routes`. We need percentile of hit latency too (p50/p95) — can runtime emit `kvcache.hit_duration_seconds_bucket` as histogram?

mira (observability): Histograms are fine but watch cardinality. If we tag latency with `prefix_hash` it explodes. Suggest latency histogram only by `workload_type` + `model_family`. For `reuse_by_workload` we should keep two flavors: `reuse_count` (high-cardinality aggregated at runtime, emitted as counters) and a sampled `reuse_example` log for debugging (1/1000).

ryan (eng-runtime): Implementation note: runtime currently records per-request KV lookups. We'll aggregate per-minute and flush metrics via gRPC to metrics-collector. Sampling: default 1:1 for counters, but for `reuse_example` we'll sample 0.1% with full prefix for debug streams.

jess (eng-platform): Can we lock on canonical metric names/label set now? If yes we can add to API docs and Console mockups. Proposed canonical list: `kvcache.hit_total{model_family,workload_type,tenant_tier,prefix_hash,exporter}`, `kvcache.miss_total{...}`, `kvcache.evictions_total{eviction_reason,...}`, `kvcache.reuse_count{workload_type,model_family,tenant_tier,exporter}`.

anika (eng-infra): +1 but change `prefix_hash` to `prefix_bucket` and define deterministic mapping with low cardinality (e.g., 256 buckets). That avoids open-ended hashes. Also add `ingest_shard` label to help debugging sharding issues.

sam (eng-console): For UX we'll surface: global hit rate (1m/1h), per-model-family trends, top workloads by reuse, and an eviction heatmap by reason. For the panel that lists sample prefixes, we will only show sampled examples and mask sensitive chars. Also add a toggle to filter to Dedicated vs Hosted traffic.

mira (observability): Aggregation windows: emit raw counters, rollup 1m aggregates for dashboards, 1h for long-term retention. Tag retention: keep high-cardinality 1m for 30d then rollup. Suggest alerts: global prefix_hit_rate < 0.6 for 5m, eviction_rate spikes > 3x baseline.

ryan (eng-runtime): Implementation plan: 1) Add counters + histograms in runtime, 2) implement prefix bucketing (256), 3) emit `reuse_example` sample stream to debug pipeline, 4) add unit tests for label cardinality. ETA: PR by EOD Friday.

anika (eng-infra): Infra tasks: update metrics-collector to accept new labels and ensure cardinality guard policies, add ingestion mapping for `prefix_bucket` -> dashboard legend, and update retention policies. I'll own deployment. ETA: next Tue.

sam (eng-console): Console tasks: wire widgets for 1m/1h/24h, create mock data for UX, and add rollout toggle for canary vs prod. Need final metric names by Monday to run mock queries.

jess (eng-platform): Action items summary:
- Runtime (ryan): PR with metric emission + prefix bucketing (by Fri)
- Infra (anika): Ingest + retention + mapping (by Tue)
- Console (sam): Mock dashboards + query templates (by Mon)
- Observability (mira): Alert thresholds + retention plan (by Mon)

ryan (eng-runtime): Sample PromQL snippets for Console: ```
# prefix hit rate (1m)
sum by(model_family) (rate(kvcache.hit_total[1m])) / (sum by(model_family) (rate(kvcache.hit_total[1m])) + sum by(model_family) (rate(kvcache.miss_total[1m])))

# eviction rate by reason
sum by(eviction_reason) (rate(kvcache.evictions_total[5m]))

# reuse per workload_type
sum by(workload_type) (increase(kvcache.reuse_count[1h])) / sum by(workload_type) (active_routes_count)
```

mira (observability): Nice. Add noise-filtering: ignore workloads with <100 lookups in window to avoid misleading ratios.

anika (eng-infra): One more: make `evictions_total` emit `evicted_keys` gauge occasionally so we can correlate memory pressure.

jess (eng-platform): Perfect. Also we should document the privacy/PII constraints: no raw tenant IDs, prefix examples must be masked. I'll file a short RFC and link it in this thread.

infra-bot: Deployment scheduled: metrics-collector v2.14 -> staging at 2024-07-17T03:15:00Z (placeholder).

sam (eng-console): I'll put together a quick Figma of dashboard tiles and paste here once ready.

jess (eng-platform): Thanks all — tagging follow-ups. I'll convert action items to GH issues and assign. :thumbsup:

mira (observability): If anyone wants to dry-run with synthetic data ping me, I can generate a workload mix to validate the deck.

ryan (eng-runtime): Will do a canary run once PR is merged, will post results here.

jess (eng-platform): Closing the sync — keeping thread open for any adjustments.
